finding.headline: "The Road-Trip-to-Village Mum"
finding.problem: "Four hours on bad roads with a screaming baby and no proper place to stop and feed. I'm dreading it more than the visit itself."
finding.person: Nigerian mum driving several hours to her in-laws'/parents' village for baby's first visit; long stretches, few safe stops, feeding & comfort logistics.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone / Module inside Niche 8 travel bundle.". Verdict: PASSES.
